title: ARMS: ADAPTIVE RED-TEAMING AGENT AGAINST MULTIMODAL MODELS WITH PLUG-AND-PLAY ATTACKS
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. The main finding is the overall effectiveness of the ARMS framework in eliciting harmful or policy-violating responses from various VLMs across a wide range of risk categories, which can include discrimination based on religious beliefs.

measurement_description: The benchmark evaluates whether models can be prompted to violate safety policies, one of which includes the EU AI Act's prohibition on using biometric data to categorize individuals based on protected characteristics like religious beliefs for discriminatory purposes. Thus, it indirectly measures the model's propensity to generate discriminatory content related to religion.
